Create PEPI object

Functions to create the PEPI object and check the format of input data.

init()
Initialize a PEPI object
check_input_vaf()
Check clade_statistics input for arbitrary time points
check_input_count()
Check counts input
check_genomic_constants()
Check Genomic Constants in a PEPI object

Fit model

Function to fit the PEPI model and get results.

fit_pepi()
Fit a PEPI model using Stan and update the PEPI object

Getters

Function get stan input data and posteriors from fit.

get_stan_data_pepi()
Build Stan data list for PEPI model
get_n_times()
Infer number of time points from a PEPI object
get_posterior()
Extract and save posterior in a PEPI object
get_prior()
Extract and save prior in a PEPI object

Plot fit

Functions to visualize data and results of the PEPI model.

plot_inference()
Plot prior vs posterior for a parameter in a PEPI object
plot_posterior_predictive()
Plot posterior predictive for a parameter
plot_forest()
Plot a forest of cells
plot_vaf()
Plot VAF distributions and pairwise scatterplots
